nom: Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 60+

avis.texte: This is the best sunscreen I have found. High SPF but cosmetically elegant enough to wear on my face every day. Doesn't sting at all, dries soft and not greasy. #sweepstakes

I personally have sensitive skin and I find this product to work for me. The sunscreen works great for the summer time obviously but after the shower makes it feel nice and refreshing. I mainly use a ton of this for the whole body and it can cover a lot. It doesn't leave any sun burns and I feel like I can trust that I would not get so affected by the sun using this. Though I highly recommend that by any means if you're with using this around the eyes or brow. If you sweat and it goes down or if you rub your eyes with the remains of the sunscreen. It will leave a bad sting towards the eye and you would maybe get a few tears out. I know from experience so I use a little bit around the face but enough so I don't get that painful affect. If I can rate it personally, it's a 8.5/10! I do love it, it's just that one thing that makes it HORTTT! 😭

avis.titre: I like the smell but it feels too greasy
avis.texte: Smells nice but feels like baby oil , which is too greasy for me.

avis.titre: Smells nice but way too greasy
avis.texte: I purchased many types of sunscreens (chemical, mineral, and the chemical stick one) from Shiseido given that one of them was in the Beauty award list. This is the first type i opened and here's my review, Pro: It smells nice. It seems to provide good sun protection although I have only not tested it extensively under direct blazing sun. I wore it at a beach and was in and out of shades, and I did not get any sunburns. Cons: it is very runny and greasy - almost like baby oil mixed with a serum or a typical chemical sun screen. Although the skin looks radiant, it just feels like there's an oily film. If you like to use baby oil in your skin, this is for you. If you like sunscreen that are matte, dry to the touch, lotion consistency (like Elta MD), or gel consistency, skip this.

I am one of the many people who hate putting on sunscreen I will avoid going out during peak uv hours just so I dont have to wear it! I had tried many brands some are clear but will my will move as i get sweaty and sting my eyes. I wear contacts so anything transferring to my eyes will burn for a long time, because of this ive been on the hunt for a clear sunscreen that doesnt have me looking crazy with a white cast or that doesnt burn or feel sticky. I got a sample of this and its the one! I finally dont dread putting on sunscreen and am reaching for it daily :) I totally recommend!
Had to repurchase this.. Very worth it. Best sunscreen brand. I love all these sunscreens!!!
I'm absolutely obsessed with this sunscreen! ☀️ It's hands down my favorite and my go-to every single day. It feels amazing on my skin, and I can't recommend it enough!
I tried using this on face and body but it was way too greasy , stings my eyes , transfers in an awful way . No white cast but It is awful product for such expensive price. Do better .

I really love this sub protector! Shake it up really well! I loke that jts made for face and body and isnt sticky feeling. I have dry skin, so i appreciate that this isn't immediately drying me out. It feels very moisturizing. Has a light scent to it but isnt overpowering and not a sunscreen smell.
I have been using this lotion since long time. I can not go other since using this lotion. Highly recommended!
Perfect, effective, smoothing, invisible, and cost-effective. Will buy it again.
Great product. Invisible, smooth, and effective to protect skin from the sun at the beach. Fair price and good amount. Will buy again. #sweepstakes

This sunscreen is my go to daily. It's easy to put on and dries nicely. It has a very pleasant scent. Four stars only because it really stings when it gets in your eyes. It would be great if this can be eliminated. Then it would be a five star product.

avis.titre: I would by this product over and over again.
avis.texte: This one feels good, goes on easily and is hydrating. My favorite!
Effective, feels good, goes on easily and is hydrating and softening.

avis.titre: Love it ... but not in the eye zone.
avis.texte: I love to use this sun protector for my early runs. I feel it stays throughout the run and keeps my face hydrated. The reason I am giving it one star less it's because I can't use it around my eyes as it stings when combined with my sweat.

avis.titre: A no go if you have oily skin
avis.texte: Unfortunately this sunscreen did not work for me at all. My skin can be slightly oily at times, and the second I put this on it just sat on top of my skin and never sunk in.

I think this is a nice sunscreen. Smells good, does not produce a cast. The issue is… it's just very oily and doesn't absorb into the skin. I have to use mattifying powder while wearing it or I look like I put oil on my face. I most likely will not repurchase this product.
Husband uses this when golfing. Keeps his shaved head from burning and looking like a tomato! #sweepstakes
This product provides very good sun protection and ut is very moist. I don't beed to use moisturizer during the day after applying this sunscreen.

avis.titre: This is  the best sunscreen ever
avis.texte: Not greasy or pasty, and it does NOT irritate my sensitive skin. Provides GREAT protection!! Do think need to say on container that it needs to be shaken before use, as the product will separate if it has sat awhile.

avis.titre: Greasy or dewy depending on how you look at it
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen for my body, but too greasy for my face. I can wear it if my skin is feeling dryer than usual. But otherwise prefer the mineral sunblock.

The bottle design is terrible- far from functional. Shiseido how did you ok this design? A traditional bottle that dispenses the product properly is what we'd like- product over packaging please. This is now sitting on bathroom shelf like a sculpture until the next time I try attempt to use it. What a mess.

I was a little tenative on purchasing this product due to the price point, but took the plunge priorr to a beach vacation. I absolutely love it. No burning of my skin but did allow for me to gain some cover. It did not have a greasy feel nor did it have that strong SPF smell. Worth the $$$$$!!!!!!

avis.titre: Has surprised me with how great it is!
avis.texte: I used a sample of this product about 6 months ago. I really liked it, and told myself to pick it up closer to summer. I'm so glad I bought the full size bottle! It actually has a slight tint to it (very light). It smells amazing. It has such a high spf for it to be in skincare. I use it as skincare, it is very light, and not greasy. It lasts for a very long time. I apply it to my entire face (except eyes), then my ears, neck, and décolletage. I also apply it to my hands/wrists, and any other open clothes upper area. It comes off easily with cleansing. I highly recommend this sunscreen, and I really am so glad I got it. I even use it in cloudy/rainy days, you get more sun than you realize at those times. Any tan causes skin damage and discoloration.
Have used Shiseido products for years. Every product I have used has worked wonderfully. Occasionally I have tried other products, and always regretted doing that. I am a customer for life!

avis.titre: I would NOT buy this again ever
avis.texte: Based on raving reviews I bought this in a larger size and so disappointed. It doesn't absorb into the skin but remains oily on top of my skin and feels sticky for the whole day. Unfortunately, I had thrown out the box otherwise I would have returned it. There is no way I can wear this below my make up or for exercise. I live in Southern California so the weather here is very dry yet the product would not absorb into my skin. I think I'm going to Let the bottle settled for a month to get the oil goes up to the top and squeeze it out before trying to use it again.
I thought this was on the pricey side when I purchased it, but it is well worth the cost and wallet offers great sun protection. It feels amazing on the skin. You will not regret this purchase.
I use this product before surfing each morning. It goes on smooth and smells great. It protects me just great for a one hour session.

This sunscreen made it to the top of the Acropolis and back, in the middle of the summer. Greece is like a sneaky desert and it was about 106 degrees that day- I made it out of that adventure with zero burns. Absolutely incredible. 5 stars, no notes.

avis.titre: I loved this. So beyond impressed!
avis.texte: I was in the sun for 5 hours straight. No shade, no hat, just a bathing suit. Im pale as can be and hardly got burned. I didnt feel like i was on fire the whole time outside. 10/10. And uv was at a 8 outside!

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying this again
avis.texte: I love my new sunscreen ❤️It goes on so smoothly and makes my skin feel great

avis.titre: Stay away if you have oily skin
avis.texte: Im an Esthetician & wanted to try this product but didnt realize it was for mature/dry skin types. If you have oily or normal combination skin please stay away from this product. I havent broken out in months but I did after a few days because this product is so "glowy" that its just greasing up your face. Im surprised this product is so over hyped because it's definitely meant for a small majority.
I use the lotion every morning after cleaning my face. I really like it. I work outdoors most days and I have helped keep my skin protected.

A few days ago I received this product from Shiseido, and honestly it is a product that I have already used before. I love it for the ease of use, the practicality for day to day and the protection it has. It is easy to touch up the protector even with makeup and even for beach days it is a must #giftedbyShideido

avis.titre: I like it so well, I gave it for Christmas.

it goes on smoothly, and is very light. I've used it for years and I really like it.
Sent me a bottle that is about to expire in the upcoming year. Ridiculous for the size of the bottle that I purchased.

This is my favorite SPF. It absorbs beautifully with absolutely no white cast. I used the SPF 50 for years and switched to the SPF 60 as soon as it launched—just as elegant, lightweight, and reliable. A daily staple for me.
Seems nice, but pricy. Heavier than most and feels like it may be protecting. I like spreading a small amount over entire face before going out for a walk. Have purchased once after using sample.
I believe this is nice sunscreen, just not for me. It made my skin feel greasy, it has strong scent that bothers me and it broke me out.
Love the product, but why discontinue the 3.4oz/100ml size? The small one is too small, and the big one can't go in a carry-on. Neither option works.

avis.titre: Good sunscreen But too greasy feeling for me

Always purchased your sun lotions and been very happy. It does protect my skin while I am out in the sun. No sun burns.

My forever best friend of the last 20 years. That sentence has said it all. Wonderful product from Shiseido. One and only sunscreen I rely on and now passing on this habit to my girl. I would give most credit of my nice skin in the 40s to this sunscreen. Never too late to start! Ty Shiseido!

avis.titre: Best sunscreen product on the market

This is just too oily for me. I messaged them about shipping it back but lost the return label since I did not realize I was going to be returning it.
I love everything about this sunscreen. It is light, easy to apply, and leaves my skin feeling amazing. I have been so much more diligent about applying sunscreen because of this great product.

avis.titre: BEST SUNSCREEN, I HAVE FINALLY FOUND

Shiseido sunscreen offers impressive protection and a luxurious feel, making it a standout product in the market. Known for its lightweight texture, it applies smoothly and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue, making it suitable for various skin types. The formula often includes added skincare benefits, such as hydration and anti-aging properties, which enhance its appeal. Additionally, its high SPF provides robust protection against harmful UV rays, ensuring your skin stays safe under the sun. Overall, Shiseido sunscreen combines effectiveness with a pleasant user experience, making it a top choice for daily sun protection.

avis.titre: This is my favorite sunscreen EVER
avis.texte: It is easy to apply, works and most of all it doesn't leave that icky, sticky, oily feel that you experience with many other sunscreens .

I had to pull over to the side of the road, my eye would not stop leaking for 10 minutes. It burns so bad and continues to burn after I rinsed my eyes out too. For the record, I do not put spf on or around my eyes either because I wear sunglasses and it STILL got in my eyes.

Smells good, absorbs into the skin great, and is just wonderful all around! Doesn't get blotchy when wet or in the water like some brands do. It's not greasy feelin at all. Definitely pricy, but a little goes a long way and it's definitely worth it.

Lightweight, absorbable, hydrating sunscreen with no residue.

I love it. I have dry sensitive skin, according to my estechian, with freckles no white cast( im poc), lightweight just that price tag so i don't buy as often as i should.

I got this online, i have never tried it before. it inmidiately sting my face really bad, is extremely oily my skin did not absorve it not even after wearing it for hours, i have tried all types of spf from cheapest to medical grade brands this is the worst spf i have ever purchased.
Love that it isn't greasy, however I get an allergic reaction . And now unable to return :(

Have been using Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protection Lotion Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ WetForce mineral sunscreen (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide) for many years and they just discontinued it. Very upset about that, it was super effective, the slight white cast faded to clear within a minute, and it kept sun spots at bay. No eye stinging even if water ran into eyes. Tried this as a replacement even though it has the chemical components that I'm trying to avoid. This product goes on oily and stays very oily all day (and I have dry skin- it's definitely the product.) It made me break out on the chin and I am over 50. It's also heavily scented, so much that the scent never goes away. I can't emphasize enough how strong this perfume is, more than any facial product I've ever used. If even a smidge gets in the eyes it burns. Hate this and will be returning. I'm not even sure it's effective because after applying in the morning and spending several hours in the car driving, I came home to brown spots/freckles on the face. Don't understand the good ratings at all unless people are using it on their body but it's not good for the face!
This lotion is very smooth on the skin and makes skin softer. Only problem is it stings on eyes when it goes in the eye. Overall, it is nice on skin.

I got skin cancer on my chest, so when I went in for surgery, I asked the lovely doctor, what do YOU use and she told me, I knew I should be using it and from that moment on 2 years I use it everyday it is sunny. The best part of this is the lotion just melt into your skin, very soft and does not smell bad. I really don't have anything negative to say, it is the BEST.

I really think this sunscreen doesn't get enough love. Its performance is second to none. It is like UV armor for my body. My skin tone is very light, but I'm not someone that always burns no matter what. I actually tan pretty easily as long as I wear some sunscreen. But because my skin is so light, it's really easy to tell when I get any color after being outside. I once lathered this on heavy in the morning before spending the entire day on a farm in Central America in the blazing sun with no shade, never reapplied, and didn't get even a hint of a tan. I'm not suggesting anyone should do that—I'm just saying, this sunscreen has really amazed me a few times when I've gone out in the sun and accidentally left it behind. No other sunscreen I've tried comes close to that level of performance. There have been so many times that I went to the beach with someone and they asked me what sunscreen I was using and I told them about it and then they swore by whatever popular brand they used then they went out in the sun and got burned! I don't know why no one believes me. A lot of the other reviews talk about wearing the sunscreen under makeup. I actually think it's a little heavy for that. It's not a daily sunscreen for me, personally, it's an outdoor/active sunscreen.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: The sun protector lotion kisses the skin so beautifully. It gives you a bit of a sparkle toned look in the sun.

I have tattoos on my arms, and I have found this has been the best! I have had it since the begining of this year, and this sunscren has been great for me. I have combination skin, and it hasn't felt greasy on my skin, although I can understand if it may feel that way initially. It does have a slight fragrance, so if that's something that bothers you that is something to take note. Great deal as you really don't need to use too much of the product for it to work and it lasts longer for me. Highy recommend especially for vacation!

I wear elta md and and I put this product before when Im out walking my dog everyday. It has really helped with less sunspots on my face and helps with not making my hyperpigmentation worse. Cant live without! Love the glow it gives as well.
Pros…. GREAT glow to the skin Protects face from sun Cons… strong grapefruit? Scent Feels very oily on the skin Maybe feels light weight to some but not for me

I've gone through the bottle of this sunscreen in what seems like record time for me as it's even a fairly large size! It's a light and sheer feeling formula that is non greasy that seems to work well for my skin without irritation! But the scent for some reason is beyond delightful it seems orangey but not overwhelming nor like regular sunscreen! Love this one.

I've been using this sunscreen daily since I received it. It has a fresh grapefruit scent. Shake well before use. Starts off feeling kinda oily, but feels amazing on the skin and a nice finish. Love it.

avis.titre: The BEST face sunscreen I've ever used!!!!
avis.texte: Seriously! This is the absolute best face sunscreen I've ever used. I've tried so many brands and kinds- all either left a white cast, made me an oil slick, or irritated my skin. Not this beauty! This sunscreen is almost serum like, super thin and silky- with a bit of shimmer and tint that adds radiance. It I didn't have rosacea, I could probably get away with wearing only this product for the way it reflects light and adds a filter-like touch. NO irritation! So many sunscreens clog my pores or make my rosacea so mad. This caused zero issues, even after weeks of use (one of the reasons I always delay my reviews). I tend to wear a decent amount of makeup and was also worried it wouldn't sit well under it or that it would give terrible white cast in photos. Nope and nope! It almost acts like a silk primer under my medium to full coverage foundation! I do get just slightly dewy by the end of a 10 hour day, but nothing a little powder didn't fix! It's rare for me to commit to a product, but this is going to be my staple sunscreen. I will be buying numerous full bottles of this!
Reach for this sunscreen often. A favorite. Invisible on skin ( esp brown/melanin skin). Leaves a soft, moisturized/silky finish on skin. Ingredients with skincare benefits are a plus.

I was a little hesitant because I've never tried any sunscreen quite like this one. However, I was pleasantly surprised. First off, let me say that a little bit goes a long way. It has a liquidy/gel like texture at first. It goes on really easy and doesn't feel greasy. Dries down really fast and has a pleasant fragrance. It's kept me from getting burned. Feels good on my skin. Would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: A Little Greasy for My Taste
avis.texte: I know that sunscreen is super important, but I just can't find one that feels normal on my skin. This one is no exception, it left me feeling greasy, which is a feeling I hate.

Most sunscreens sting or irritate my face, especially by my eyes so I am always nervous trying new ones. With that being said, I had ZERO irritation or stinging! This product feels almost like a primer - which I love because it feels so silky VS other sunscreens that can feel sticky. Another great perk is that it is 60+ instead of the normal 30-50. The only con I have about this product is that the scent is a little strong, but other than that it is a great product and would definitely recommend it. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

5 stars for Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion. The SPF 60+ kept me from burning on vacation in the hot Florida sun. It has a light almost citrus scent and it glides on so easily giving maximum coverage a.d protection. Perfect for face and body.

It's very lightweight. Thin consistency that spreads easily. I didn't have any pilling and was able to wear it with my usual skincare. It didn't have the heavy sunscreen feel either and left no white cast.

I was pleasantly surprised when I was chosen to review this product for Bzzagent. I have been trying to find a go to lotion with spf that didn't break me out and still looked good under my daily products and I think this is it. First thing I noticed was the lightweight formula it feels good and actually moisturizes my face. Now you may have a little shine or even feel a little greasy at first but after a few minutes this sinks into your skin and leaves a beautiful glow. My makeup applies so beautifully after this step and I love that there isn't much of a scent. Although I was gifted this product I will definitely purchase again.
